_comment: The canonical host form, as a table, so the producer (serp-discover's
brand_utils.normalise_domain) are checked against one definition rather
than against each other's source text. Review chunk Y1's cold review: the
guard before this one grepped the sibling repo for the ALIAS_PREFIXES
constant, so it proved the prefix list and never the rule -- and compete's
copy kept the scheme, the path, the port and the userinfo the whole time.
This file is byte-identical in both repos and a test on each side asserts
that, the same arrangement handoff_schema.json uses.
